text:
I rewrote the outcome of `mastermind-figma-live-board`, and `text-check` now comes back clean. I didn't open any pages or take screenshots.

The old outcome was one 111-word paragraph, and `text-check` flagged it. It is now a ticked checklist with links:
- The Live page and its board are done.
- The old same-named page was renamed, not overwritten.
- The resize-order trap is fixed and documented in `live-board.md`.
- Live follow-up updates are still open (`- [ ]`), since the agent stays alive for them.

The task has no `requirements.md`, so I couldn't check the ticks against the owner's actual asks. I took the ticked items from the old outcome.

I appended the new outcome to the task's `session.jsonl`. I also logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`.
